```python
def run(inp):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=inp.encode() if isinstance(inp,str) else inp, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')

def fp(data):
    n = len(data); h = 0
    for i, b in enumerate(data):
        h = (h + (b + 1) * pow(257, n - 1 - i, 1 << 64)) % (1 << 64)
    return {'n': n, 'h': format(h, '016x')}
```

```python
def act(t, s, kind, content_pairs_or_bytes, end):

    else:

    out += b'\x01' if end else b'\x00'
    return out
```
